scope.scope_hint: Exactly four named proof tests; three untracked Python files explicitly included as current raw bytes without staging.

intent: Review exactly four authored batch50 proof tests for useful finite-model and negative-control assertions against actual packet inputs. Fixed independent expectations, emitted observations before assertion, and meaningful in-memory wrong-input rejection must guard against false greens; no engine behavior or NLP validation is implied.

requirements_completeness.review_scope: Runnable claim-test substep only; broader course authoring/publication requirements are outside this review.
checks: Actual packet inputs feed independent finite calculations for all 50 courses.
Both model and negative cases compare calculated values to separate fixed expectations and packet expected values.
Normal model/negative observations precede assertion of computed results.
Concrete model and negative in-memory wrong-input probes reject even when packet expected outputs are updated consistently; canonical data is preserved.
gaps: AUD014 alignment assumption is unenforced: an unmatched sample is silently dropped and the proof stays green (finding 1).
